name: Dianna D. Bennett
occupation: Sheridan County and prosecuting attorney (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Sheridan County and prosecuting attorney (listed on the official prosecuting attorney page; she was re-elected in 2026)
background: Dianna D. Bennett is the Sheridan County and prosecuting attorney and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official prosecuting attorney page lists her in that office and describes the office's work as civil legal counsel for the county and as prosecutor in felony, misdemeanor, and juvenile cases arising in the county.
